# REQ: LANG-501 LANG-502 LANG-503 LANG-504 terraform { required_version = ">= 1.5" } variable "region" { type = string default = "eu-central-1" } // Instance resource resource "aws_instance" "web" { count = var.enabled ? 2 : 0 ami = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id instance_type = "t3.micro" tags = { Name = "web-${count.index}" } user_data = <<-EOT #!/bin/bash echo "hello ${var.region}" EOT } /* Outputs */ output "ids" { value = [for i in aws_instance.web : upper(i.id) if i.id != null] }
